lines.name: Mithi
lines.words: abhūd videho 'sya piteti vaideho mathanān mithir abhūt

lines.name: Vatsa
lines.words: tena ca prītimatātmaputro vatsa vatsety abhihitas

lines.name: Rāma
lines.words: daśarathasyāpi bhagavān abjanābho jagatsthityartham ātmāṃśena rāmalakṣmaṇabharataśatrughnarūpiṇā caturdhā putratvam āyāsīt

lines.name: Apratiratha
lines.words: sumatim apratirathaṃ dhruvaṃ ca rantināraḥ putrān avāpa

lines.name: Vijaya
lines.words: jayadratho brahmakṣatrāntarālasaṃbhūtyāṃ patnyāṃ vijayaṃ nāma putram ajījanat

lines.name: Titikṣu
lines.words: tasmād apy uśīnaratitikṣū dvau putrāv utpannau

lines.name: Aṅga
lines.words: yasya kṣetre dīrghatamasā aṅgavaṅgakaliṅgasuhyapauṇḍrākhyaṃ bāleyaṃ kṣatram ajanyata

lines.name: Kṛpa
lines.words: satyadhṛtes tu varāpsarasam urvaśīṃ dṛṣṭvā retaḥ skannaṃ

lines.name: Balabhadra
lines.words: balabhadrasāraṇaśaṭhadurmadādīn putrān rohiṇyām ānakadundubhir utpādayām āsa

lines.name: Yudhiṣṭhira
lines.words: tasyāṃ ca dharmānilaśakrair yudhiṣṭhirabhīmārjunākhyās trayaḥ putrāḥ samutpāditāḥ

lines.name: Śunaḥśepa
lines.words: viśvāmitraputras tu bhārgava eva śunaḥśepo devair dattaḥ

lines.name: Dantavakra
lines.words: vṛddhaśarmā nāma kārūśa upayeme tasyāṃ dantavakro
